verdict.rationale: Render's own marketing page claims "Free TLS certificates for every domain, including wildcards," and its docs list a Custom domains feature, which covers the free, every-domain and wildcard parts of the story. Nothing in the pack documents automatic renewal, and the TLS claim is a single marketing line rather than a detailed doc page. missing for 10: documented automatic certificate renewal, in-depth first-party TLS/certificate documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration of wildcard certificate issuance.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can get free, automatically renewing TLS certificates for every domain including wildcards

citations.quote: Free TLS certificates for every domain, including wildcards.
